en: A hand‑colored vintage postcard depicting a large two‑story house with a steep red tiled roof, half-timbered upper gable, and stucco walls. The building stands behind a low fence along a street with lampposts. Text at the top identifies the location as Oberfrohna i. Sa. and labels the building as the parish office (Pfarramt). Additional small German text is printed along the bottom margin, including a reference to the photographer O. Wichmann and the notation that it is a hand-colored artist postcard.
